//: Copy this file to cairn.config.json and edit for your machine. cairn.config.json is git-ignored. 'cairn config init' writes this template (with your --data-root / --enable choices) to ~/.config/cairn/config.json.
//data_root: Directory under which each collection's exported markdown is written (one subfolder per collection). Conventionally a git-ignored .context/ so the repo stays shareable.
//qmd_binary: Path to the qmd executable, or just 'qmd' if it is on your PATH (use an absolute path if cron's minimal PATH can't find it).
//cron: Optional. Schedule for 'cairn sync --cron' as a standard 5-field crontab expression. Defaults to '7 * * * *' (hourly at minute 7) when omitted.
//invoke: Optional. Defaults for 'cairn invoke <peer>' (codex, claude or antigravity run headlessly from either host). model/effort null = let the peer CLI choose. profile: review (read-only) | edit (workspace writes) | full (no sandbox). Timeouts in seconds: timeout_s is the wall clock, idle_timeout_s kills a run with no activity, quiet_after_s/stall_after_s drive the activity labels in 'cairn invoke status'.
//invoke.antigravity.billing: Optional, antigravity only: which credits a headless agy run bills. route: inherit (the host shell's environment decides, the default) | plan (consumer plan quota: AGY_ADC_AUTH is stripped) | gcp (Vertex AI through Application Default Credentials, billed to the GCP quota project; the run is refused before anything is spawned unless the ADC file and a quota project exist, and the route agy took is read back from its log). project/location export GOOGLE_CLOUD_QUOTA_PROJECT / GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION when set; null leaves the ADC file's quota_project_id and agy's default location. `cairn invoke antigravity --billing ROUTE` overrides the route for one round.
//collections: Each key is BOTH the QMD collection name AND the output subdirectory under data_root.
//sync: Per-collection sync policy (config-as-data). 'enabled' is the integration on/off switch the engine reads - disabled sources are skipped by 'cairn sync'. 'since' is the export window (today|yesterday|Nd|Nw|YYYY-MM-DD). 'on_hook': false opts out of the originating host's SessionEnd sync (otherwise enabled). Legacy 'sync --hook' still defaults to Claude. Omitting the whole block means enabled with a 1d window.

extra.description: Collection-level QMD context for all service docs.

service-docs.//service_sources: service name -> docs directory to mirror into the collection.

api.description: Describe this service for QMD context.

//path_resolution: Optional. Used to map agent project dirs to project/repo names. home_slug_prefixes is derived from your home dir if omitted.
//project_groups: Maps a directory-name prefix to its grouped project folder (e.g. worktrees -> parent repo). The optional key 'superset-worktrees' names the project that .superset worktrees belong to.
//repo_catalog: project group -> { repo name: description }. Drives repo subfolders and QMD context.
//project_descriptions: Top-level project -> human description, attached to QMD as context.
